description:
Goal: compile work proportional to the program. Every job runs once its inputs
exist; a job re-runs only when a fact it read has changed its answer.

Signal: runs vs distinct subjects per job kind, and the wake cause of every
re-run (`work_graph.applied` completions list the facts changed and the jobs
woken). Strategy: `.agent/strategies/paper-first.md` — shrink to one question,
answer it by hand before reading the implementation, watch the system show its
steps, fix where the first difference starts, return to the original.

Reduced case (develop @ d91cae495, debug):
  def main(), do: Enum.take([1, 2, 3], 2)
  fz2 --log-telemetry take.jsonl interp take.fz
measures 1054 jobs over 536 distinct subjects: 518 re-runs. Floor for
`def main(), do: 1` is 44 jobs.

Measured re-runs by kind and wake cause:
| kind | runs | subjects | re-run woken by |
|---|---|---|---|
| DefineFunction | 110 | 55 | ExpandedFunctionSource arriving (55) |
| LowerFunction | 112 | 60 | FunctionDefined arriving (52) |
| DeriveStaticCallees | 125 | 63 | LoweredBody (57), ModuleDefined (5) |
| DeriveCallGraphComponent | 53 | 36 | StaticCallees (17) |
| DefineModule | 15 | 5 | CodeIndexed (4), CodeScoped (4) |
| DeriveInputDemand | 127 | 36 | EntryDispatch one callee at a time (52), StaticCallees (34); Enum.take/2 alone 16 runs |
| DeriveRuntimeDemand | 158 | 40 | ExecutableFacts settled (40), RuntimeDemandInputs (74) |
| AnalyzeActivation | 130 | 41 | callee ReturnType current (43), InputDemand (22), Recursive (16) |

Consequence: seven census tests exceed nextest's 16s slow-timeout on develop
(identical on develop and on the fz-kmu branch): canon_is_faithful_over_the_full_arena_of_both_target_fixtures,
compiler2_no_value_reaches_a_construction_member_that_never_named_it,
compiler2_a_permuted_arm_order_renders_the_same_artifact,
compiler2_dispatch_blind_escape_census_is_the_known_population,
compiler2_dispatch_answers_the_same_under_a_permuted_arm_order,
compiler2_dispatch_answers_the_same_under_a_permuted_wrapper_order,
compiler2_dispatch_lists_its_bodies_in_the_graphs_first_match_order.
Each compiles 13-22 fixtures under 2-4 permutations; the slowest fixtures
(debug interp) are 00420/behavior enum_take_drop_split 2.6s, enum_map_family
1.4s, 00277_enum_tier0_fixture 1.4s, enum_predicate_search 1.3s. They pass
in-process under `cargo test`. The full enum_take_drop_split compile is 3813
jobs, which is the work_start_reason census pin; main/0 there is analyzed 48
times.

Epic acceptance: no fixture-matrix trial counts as passed without running (fz-afu.16), and kind: test fixtures run on all three paths including fz2 build (fz-afu.17); each child's reduced case matches its predicted succession;
the seven tests finish inside nextest's limit; every work pin that moves goes
DOWN, with the cause named.
title: Every job runs once its inputs exist
